SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
SPECIAL BRANCH /Statich/ File No.................... Date May 27th., 1941.

SUBJECT: IZAK MARKUS KURZ.

Izak Markus KURZ, Polish of Jewish extraction,
married, merchant by calling, was born on October 28th.,
1900 at Kalusz, Poland.
In 1922 he left Poland for Germany and resided in
that country until 1938 when he left for Paris, France.
After a short sojourn in France he went to Tel-Aviv,
Palestine and resided there until October 1940 when he
left for Shanghai arriving here in November 1940.
He is not in Shanghai at present. He left Shanghai
for Kobe on May 25th., 1941 by the s.s." Tayio Maru " and
is expected to be back at the begining of next month.
He is said to have gone to Japan on a business trip.
His Shanghai's address is at 321/1 Route Duplex.
He is in possession of a Polish passport
No. 32584/7063-39 issued by the local Polish Consulate-
General on December 18th., 1940.
He is considered to be financially well-off and
he has two accounts in U.S. currency in the Chase Bank
and in the American Express Company.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to his character.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH MAY 28 1941）
A.C. (SPECIAL BRANCH).

（右上角印章内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE BR. REGISTRY No. 877 28 5 41）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密报告
特务处 /Statich/ 档案号.................... 日期：1941年5月27日。

主题：伊扎克·马库斯·库尔茨。

伊扎克·马库斯·库尔茨，波兰籍，犹太裔，已婚，职业为商人，1900年10月28日出生于波兰卡卢什（Kalusz）。
1922年，他离开波兰前往德国，并在该国居住至1938年，随后前往法国巴黎。
在法国短暂停留后，他前往巴勒斯坦特拉维夫，并在那里居住至1940年10月，之后动身前往上海，于1940年11月抵达此地。
他目前不在上海。他于1941年5月25日乘坐“大阳丸”号轮船（s.s. "Tayio Maru"）离开上海前往神户，预计将于下月初返回。
据称他是因公务前往日本。
他在上海的住址是杜美路（Route Duplex）321/1号。
他持有波兰护照，号码为32584/7063-39，由当地波兰总领事馆于1940年12月18日签发。
据信他经济宽裕，在大通银行（Chase Bank）和美国运通公司（American Express Company）开有两个美元账户。
工部局警务处档案中没有任何不利于其品行的记录。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务处 1941年5月28日）
助理总监（特务处）。

（右上角印章内容：上海公共租界工部局警务处 登记处 第877号 28 5 41）

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAI.
14th May, 1941.

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I should be grateful for any report you could
let me have on IZAK MARKUS KURZ, who holds Polish
passport 016421 issued at Tel-Aviv, Palestine, on the
28th December 1939. He is registered as a Polish
citizen at the Polish Consulate and is, I understand,
recommended by Mr. E. P. Betchitch, President of the
Association of Yugoslav Residents in China.

In December 1940 he applied to me for a visa
for Australia, but his reasons for a visit, and his
general unsatisfactory answers, both to me and to Mr.
Wootton, the Assistant Australian Government Trade
Commissioner were most unsatisfactory, and we both
agreed that he could not be given any visa for Aus-
tralia without prior reference to the Commonwealth
authorities.

This same man, Izak Markus Kurz, turned up
to-day with a visa for Cuba and asked for a visa for
Canada, making no reference to his previous call of
a few months ago, and giving a different address in
Shanghai. The first address he gave was 65, Route
Mayen, and his present address is 321 Route Dupleix.

In accordance with standing instructions I
also refused to grant him a visa for Canada and as his
general attitude and explanations are still most
mysterious I should be grateful for any additional
information you can unearth regarding this man.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S. I.

上海。
1941年5月14日。

尊敬的沙曼先生：

如蒙提供有关伊扎克·马库斯·库尔茨的任何报告，我将不胜感激。此人持有1939年12月28日在巴勒斯坦特拉维夫签发的波兰护照，号码为016421。他在波兰领事馆注册为波兰公民，据我了解，他是由在华南斯拉夫居民协会主席 E. P. 贝奇奇（E. P. Betchitch）（音译）先生推荐的。

1940年12月，他曾向我申请澳大利亚签证，但他访澳的理由，以及他对我和澳大利亚政府助理贸易专员伍顿（Wootton）先生所作的一般性回答均极不能令人满意，因此我们两人一致认为，在未事先征询英联邦当局意见的情况下，不能向他签发任何澳大利亚签证。

同一个人，伊扎克·马库斯·库尔茨，今天持古巴签证出现，并申请加拿大签证，对几个月前的上次来访只字未提，且提供的上海地址与之前不同。他第一次提供的地址是迈恩路（Route Mayen）65号，而他现在的地址是杜美路（Route Dupleix）321号。

根据常规指令，我也拒绝向他签发加拿大签证，鉴于他的总体态度和解释仍然极其神秘，如蒙挖掘有关此人的任何其他信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

V. 沙曼 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

S. I.
14/5
